nodes.heading: Relay routes both players into the region
nodes.text: ensure_account on kg-global -> RoutePlayer outbox -> kg-relay -> handle_route_player writes the player row

nodes.heading: Server puts both players in the world
nodes.text: enter_world inserts online_player; health and weapon rows; the subscriptions start; players become aggro candidates

nodes.heading: Server spawns the Gorgon
nodes.text: admin_spawn_enemy(gorgon, 1, q, r): require_admin, resolve key at step 1, wrap anchor, slot_of_pos, mint_entity_id, seed derive

nodes.heading: Server inserts the Gorgon rows
nodes.text: enemy row (template, difficulty, seed, anchor, slot, empty phases/targets, dead_tick None) + enemy_health hp=max_hp=1000; audit; fires nothing yet

nodes.heading: Spawn refused
nodes.text: every check before the first insert; Err rolls back

nodes.heading: Both clients receive the Gorgon rows
nodes.text: nearby_enemies / nearby_enemy_health in subscribe_region, AoI ring -> EnemySeen -> ModelEvent::Enemy -> WorldModel.enemies, combat_rev -> CombatRuntime::sync EnemyUpsert

nodes.heading: Both clients receive the Gorgon rows
nodes.text: same heading as P1

nodes.heading: P1 sees the Gorgon
nodes.text: KgEnemySpawnerComponent2D instances enemy.tscn; position_at from the anchor, lerp by fraction; nova fallback; 1000/1000 bar

nodes.heading: P2 sees the Gorgon
nodes.text: same body on the same sub-unit, nearest torus copy to P2's focus; only while in P2's ring

nodes.heading: Both clients report their movement
nodes.text: KgPositionSyncComponent -> report_movement on a segment change or the 500 ms heartbeat

nodes.heading: Both clients report their movement
nodes.text: same heading

nodes.heading: Rule - accept_movement
nodes.text: require_online_woke (Quiet), alive (Dead), judge_report: rate token (RateLimited), charge slow-down, grapple allowance, check_report (Rejected); Verdict MoveAccepted / MoveRefused

nodes.heading: Server records both player tracks
nodes.text: report_movement applies the verdict: touch_presence, store_report (player_position), push_track_sample (player_track, movement_log), set_player_patch

nodes.heading: Both clients receive the tracks
nodes.text: my_track / nearby_tracks -> TrackSeen -> ModelEvent::Track -> sync_tracks; zero-velocity staircase (F1)

nodes.heading: Both clients receive the tracks
nodes.text: same heading

nodes.heading: Server runs the 1 Hz combat pass
nodes.text: combat_pass order: quiet_pass (presence), aggro_pass, cleanup_dead; why presence goes first

nodes.heading: Server aggro pass picks P1
nodes.text: candidates: online, alive, in the ring, position predicted from player_track; next_target nearest anchor within 16 hexes, tie lower id

nodes.heading: Server stamps the target and phase 0
nodes.text: TargetSegment{P1, t+60}, locked_until t+1860, first engagement PhaseSegment{0, t+60}; one row update

nodes.heading: Nobody in aggro range
nodes.text: no candidate: no change, no write; repeats next second

nodes.heading: P1 receives the target and phase 0
nodes.text: nearby_enemies update = insert(new)+delete(old); region_has_enemy keeps it; one upsert, combat_rev, re-derive

nodes.heading: P2 receives the same schedule
nodes.text: same update on P2; P2 is not the target and that changes nothing

nodes.heading: Both clients wait out the preload and the rest
nodes.text: target_at None until t+60; engaged_at true from t+60; phase 0 [rest 120][clip 528]; first shot >= t+60+120+33

nodes.heading: Both clients wait out the preload and the rest
nodes.text: same heading

nodes.heading: P1 runs the phase 0 schedule each tick
nodes.text: clip_tick_of (rest/clip), fires_at (window), fires_shot (cadence); engaged and alive gates; emitter (phase<<8)|index

nodes.heading: P2 derives the same volleys
nodes.text: same row, seed and tick -> same BulletKeys; only aim input can differ

nodes.heading: P1 aims the targeted ring
nodes.text: aim_angle: Fixed = base+spin; Target reads aim_point at fire_tick-15 (AIM_DELAY_TICKS) on the target's canonical path; no sample -> Fixed

nodes.heading: P1 expands each volley into bullets
nodes.text: volley_rng_enemy(seed, emitter, fire_tick); three draws per bullet; BulletKey{fire_tick, source, emitter, ordinal}

nodes.heading: P1 steps and draws the boss bullets
nodes.text: Bullet::step order, remainder, spawn tick integrated, life cap 720; KgBulletLayerComponent2D MultiMesh per family

nodes.heading: Both clients print the same digest
nodes.text: spawn_digest every 600 ticks recomputed from rows and tracks; HUD combat digest line

nodes.heading: P1 builds a body for each player
nodes.text: one Body per connected player: Track from reported samples, Life from health, canonical vs exact collision mode

nodes.heading: P1 resolver decides P1 was hit
nodes.text: capsule_hits_circle radius 307; earliest (tick, player id) wins; immediate report mode decides own contact at once

nodes.heading: P2 resolver reaches the same verdict
nodes.text: remote contact decided once no earlier one is possible; CONFIRM_MAX_WAIT 120

nodes.heading: P1 holds the contact, then consumes the bullet
nodes.text: REPORT_HOLD_TICKS 12; a new BulletPath serial retracts; handed out -> Input::Consumed, bullet vanishes

nodes.heading: P1 reports the hit
nodes.text: take_reports, flush_reports while clock settled, HIT_BATCH_MAX 64, PlayerHitReport fields

nodes.heading: Rule - accept_player_damaged
nodes.text: report_player_damaged calls it: caller is victim; require_online, batch > 64 Err, player_health row, empty Ok(None); sort order; TakenBatch

nodes.heading: Rule - TakenJudge.judge
nodes.text: per entry: kg_rules::enemy_bullet::judge -> dead, duplicate, no_enemy, check_hit (window, enemy_shot, enemy_hit_window), off_path, rate_limited

nodes.heading: Server applies the hit to P1
nodes.text: report_player_damaged: apply_player_hit: resolve 10 vs defence 0, hp 100->90, recent_hits; TakenJudge::accepted, hit_log, TakenJudge::save

nodes.heading: P1 HP bar drops to 110
nodes.text: my_health -> HealthSeen -> ModelEvent::Health -> KgHealthBar

nodes.heading: P2 sees P1 at 110 HP
nodes.text: nearby_health -> KgRemotePlayer::set_health; Life for P2's resolver

nodes.heading: P1 bullet store is full
nodes.text: LIVE_BULLET_CAP 20000; rest of batch rejected in key order; HUD rej; the one place a corrected re-run differs

nodes.heading: P1 walks out of the AoI ring
nodes.text: view deletes the row -> EnemyRemove -> rederive away; P1 derives nothing

nodes.heading: The Gorgon keeps P1 as its target
nodes.text: aggro_pass keep rule: lock live, online, alive, within leash 32768

nodes.heading: P1 leaves the leash
nodes.text: keep fails; re-pick P2 (+60) or disengage (+12); ends

nodes.heading: P1 walks back into range
nodes.text: row returns; body re-derived in place; bullets in flight appear

nodes.heading: A black bullet on P2
nodes.text: prediction vs undecided contact; black means might be gone

nodes.heading: P2 paths say P2 was hit first
nodes.text: different samples, staircase F1, F3; P2 reports the same key

nodes.heading: Server accepts both victims
nodes.text: no cross-player rule; per-victim guard keys; F4 counter

nodes.heading: A taken hit is refused
nodes.text: reason codes in order, hit_log, reducer Ok

nodes.heading: Too many taken hits
nodes.text: 30 hits/s bucket; batch over 64 is Err

nodes.heading: What a taken refusal costs
nodes.text: no HP change, no event; bullet already consumed locally

nodes.heading: Live hit check is on
nodes.text: admin switches; bullet_touches_path replays the bullet against movement_log

nodes.heading: Replay misses, off_path
nodes.text: same function, no margin; F1 can refuse an honest victim

nodes.heading: P2 fires the bow
nodes.text: KgWeaponComponent fire action, refusals (build mode, GUI, control inactive), cursor -> binary angle

nodes.heading: P2 adds the arrows and sends report_fire
nodes.text: KgCombatComponent::try_fire RTT <= 300 ms; CombatRuntime::try_fire cadence 15 ticks; arrows in P2's own world; NetSession::report_fire(fire_tick, origin, angle)

nodes.heading: P2 arrow hits the Gorgon
nodes.text: CombatWorld collides player bullets with enemies alive at the tick; radius 768; non-pierce removed

nodes.heading: Rule - accept_fire
nodes.text: report_fire calls it: online, alive, weapon row and mode, position row; check_fire: window -30/+2, stamp (cadence), muzzle bound

nodes.heading: Server appends the ShotRec
nodes.text: report_fire applies FireAccepted: ShotRec{fire_tick, weapon_id, mode, origin, angle} into recent_shots (16), last_fire_tick; volley never stored

nodes.heading: P2 holds and reports the dealt hit
nodes.text: REPORT_HOLD 12; take_reports; flush_reports; EnemyHitReport{enemy, fire_tick, ordinal, hit_tick}

nodes.heading: P1 receives the shot ring
nodes.text: nearby_weapons -> WeaponSeen -> ModelEvent::Weapon -> combat_rev -> sync_remote_shots -> Input::Shot; P2 skips its own row

nodes.heading: P1 expands the arrow from the shot ring
nodes.text: volley_rng_player(P2, weapon, mode, fire_tick); same three arrows drawn

nodes.heading: Rule - accept_enemy_damaged
nodes.text: report_enemy_damaged calls it: online, batch <= 64, alive, weapon row; sort; Strength, dealt_rate_ceiling, load_dealt_ledger; DealtBatch

nodes.heading: P1 collides the arrow without reporting
nodes.text: P1's world collides P2's arrows too and removes them at contact, but only the shooter reports

nodes.heading: Rule - DealtJudge.judge
nodes.text: six checks: find_shot, score, dealt key, enemy, check_hit, dealt token; damage from the shot's mode

nodes.heading: Server applies damage to the Gorgon
nodes.text: report_enemy_damaged: DealtHit damage 0 -> apply_enemy_hit -> resolve 10-8=2 -> apply_enemy_hp 1000->998; recent_hits; DealtJudge::accepted / save; no shoot-back while locked

nodes.heading: P1 boss bar drops to 998
nodes.text: nearby_enemy_health -> EnemyHealthSeen -> update_rows -> set_health + flash

nodes.heading: P2 boss bar drops to 998
nodes.text: same bar; P2 skips its own recent_hits entries

nodes.heading: P1 consumes the arrow from recent_hits
nodes.text: sync_consumed turns P2's DealtHit into Input::Consumed where P1's world missed the contact

nodes.heading: P2 drops out
nodes.text: closed socket -> client_disconnected; silent -> quiet_pass after 5 s

nodes.heading: Server removes P2 and moves it to the spawn
nodes.text: online_player deleted; disconnect nexus: a living P2 moves to the spawn slot (+ nexus mark if in danger); leaves aggro candidates

nodes.heading: P2 puppet vanishes on P1
nodes.text: nearby_players delete -> PlayerRemove -> puppet freed; not a body

nodes.heading: P2 reconnects
nodes.text: Backoff; resubscribe replays rows; enter_world / wake_quiet

nodes.heading: Server refuses report_fire
nodes.text: check_fire refusal codes; Err; ActionError on P2

nodes.heading: P2 keeps a phantom arrow
nodes.text: added locally before the call; hits refused no_shot

nodes.heading: P1 fire is held while the clock settles
nodes.text: RTT gate; reports wait

nodes.heading: Late rows trigger a correction
nodes.text: rederive from tick T; held contacts retracted

nodes.heading: A long stall restarts the world
nodes.text: MAX_CATCHUP_TICKS; runtime restart

nodes.heading: A dealt hit is refused
nodes.text: no_shot, unknown_weapon, duplicate, no_enemy, check_hit codes, rate_limited

nodes.heading: What a dealt refusal costs
nodes.text: arrow differs by screen; spectators keep it until life ends

nodes.heading: The target lock expires
nodes.text: lock not renewed (F5); fight past t+1860

nodes.heading: Shoot-back retargets to P2
nodes.text: apply_enemy_hit appends TargetSegment{P2} when lock expired

nodes.heading: P2 becomes the target
nodes.text: aimed emitters read P2's track

nodes.heading: An admin sets the Gorgon HP
nodes.text: admin_set_enemy_hp: same sink apply_enemy_hp, can jump phases, refuses hp > max_hp

nodes.heading: Server stamps phase 1
nodes.text: hp <= 900: phase_for_hp, hp_floor, PhaseSegment{1} at max(now+12, last+1)

nodes.heading: P1 sees phase 1 begin
nodes.text: row update; segment_at answers phase 1 from the stamp; the timeline restarts with a rest

nodes.heading: P2 sees phase 1 begin
nodes.text: same stamp, same tick

nodes.heading: Server refuses hits after the segment start
nodes.text: enemy_hit_window: after_segment for phase 0 bullets hitting at/after the stamp

nodes.heading: Both clients cull the bullets in flight
nodes.text: CombatWorld cull at the segment start: every phase 0 bullet gone, no message

nodes.heading: Both clients cull the bullets in flight
nodes.text: same heading

nodes.heading: One hit crosses two thresholds
nodes.text: one segment for the highest phase reached; hp_floor
